options.content:
# Catalog  
[⌂ HOME](/d/dpp-home) · [SALES](/d/dpp-sales) · **CATALOG** · ADS · [INVENTORY](/d/dpp-inventory) · FINANCE · TRAJECTORY · [DATA HEALTH](/d/dpp-data-health)  
*State is a directional operating signal based on recent sales velocity, not a permanent product classification.*

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM core.sku WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND active;
SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_sku)::int AS value FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 AND units>0;

WITH a AS (SELECT count(*)::numeric n FROM core.sku WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND active), p AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_sku)::numeric n FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 AND units>0) SELECT 100*p.n/NULLIF(a.n,0) AS value FROM a,p;

WITH a AS (SELECT count(*)::numeric n FROM core.sku WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND active), s AS (SELECT COALESCE(sum(sales),0) v FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27) SELECT s.v/NULLIF(a.n,0) AS value FROM a,s;

WITH s AS (SELECT seller_sku,sum(sales) v FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY seller_sku), r AS (SELECT v,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY v DESC) rn FROM s) SELECT 100*sum(v) FILTER (WHERE rn<=3)/NULLIF(sum(v),0) AS value FROM r;

WITH firsts AS (SELECT seller_sku,min(business_date) first_sale FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' GROUP BY seller_sku), s AS (SELECT d.seller_sku,sum(d.sales) sales,max(f.first_sale) first_sale FROM mart.sku_daily d JOIN firsts f USING(seller_sku) WHERE d.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND d.business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY d.seller_sku) SELECT 100*sum(sales) FILTER (WHERE first_sale>=CURRENT_DATE-55)/NULLIF(sum(sales),0) AS value FROM s;

WITH s AS (SELECT seller_sku,max(asin) asin,min(business_date) first_sale,sum(sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-6) t7,sum(sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27) t28,sum(sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-55 AND CURRENT_DATE-28) p28,sum(sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-55) t56,sum(units) FILTER (WHERE business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27) units28 FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' GROUP BY seller_sku), t AS (SELECT asin,sum(sessions) sessions28,sum(units_ordered) traffic_units28 FROM core.asin_sales_traffic_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27 GROUP BY asin) SELECT s.seller_sku AS "SKU",COALESCE(k.title,'') AS "Product",round(COALESCE(s.t7,0),0) AS "T7",round(COALESCE(s.t28,0),0) AS "T28",CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.p28,0)>0 THEN round(100*(s.t28-s.p28)/s.p28,0) END AS "Δ28 %",round(COALESCE(s.t56,0),0) AS "T56",COALESCE(t.sessions28,0) AS "Sessions",CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.sessions28,0)>0 THEN round(100.0*t.traffic_units28/t.sessions28,1) END AS "CVR %",COALESCE(i.fulfillable_quantity,0) AS "Stock",CASE WHEN s.first_sale>=CURRENT_DATE-27 THEN 'NEW' WHEN COALESCE(s.p28,0)>0 AND s.t28>=s.p28*1.25 AND COALESCE(s.t7,0)/7 > COALESCE(s.t28,0)/28*1.15 THEN 'ACCELERATING' WHEN COALESCE(s.p28,0)>0 AND s.t28>=s.p28*1.10 THEN 'GROWING' WHEN COALESCE(s.t28,0)>0 AND COALESCE(s.t7,0)/7 < s.t28/28*0.65 THEN 'COOLING' WHEN COALESCE(s.p28,0)>0 AND s.t28<s.p28*0.80 THEN 'DECLINING' ELSE 'STABLE' END AS "State" FROM s LEFT JOIN core.sku k ON k.sku=s.seller_sku LEFT JOIN t ON t.asin=s.asin LEFT JOIN mart.inventory_current i ON i.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND i.seller_sku=s.seller_sku ORDER BY COALESCE(s.t28,0) DESC;
SELECT business_date::timestamp AS time,sales AS value FROM mart.sku_daily WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND seller_sku='${sku}' AND business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-89 ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT a.business_date::timestamp AS time,a.sessions AS value FROM core.asin_sales_traffic_daily a JOIN core.sku s ON s.asin=a.asin AND s.marketplace_id=a.marketplace_id WHERE a.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND s.sku='${sku}' AND a.business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-89 ORDER BY a.business_date;
SELECT COALESCE(fulfillable_quantity,0) AS value FROM mart.inventory_current WHERE marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND seller_sku='${sku}';

SELECT 100.0*sum(a.units_ordered)/NULLIF(sum(a.sessions),0) AS value FROM core.asin_sales_traffic_daily a JOIN core.sku s ON s.asin=a.asin AND s.marketplace_id=a.marketplace_id WHERE a.marketplace_id='A1AM78C64UM0Y8' AND s.sku='${sku}' AND a.business_date>=CURRENT_DATE-27;
